Resident 2, do you think a physical drop box needs a daily clearance schedule to prevent it from overflowing?

A daily clearance may be unnecessary if reports are rare, but agree a named collector, a regular schedule, and an overflow check. Keep the box locked and explain how reports—especially personal details—will be handled.

If a waymark is faded or missing, pause at the last point you can identify confidently and check a current, verified map or route description. Don’t guess, follow an unverified track, or split up; if the way isn’t clear, retrace your steps or turn back. Once safe, note the location and date and report it through a confirmed channel.
